query: I finally got around to watching that new indie cat rescue documentary last night, I cried three separate times when they showed the tiny kittens getting adopted into their forever homes. I also just baked a batch of chocolate chip cookies this morning, they came out perfectly chewy in the middle and crispy around the edges, I left a plate out for my neighbor earlier. Oh and my pothos plant that I’ve been trying to keep alive for a year just grew three new leaves this week, I’m so proud of how it’s thriving. Anyway, I need help with two of my pending orders please: could you cancel order #W8268610 for me, the reason is I no longer need the items in it, and could you update the shipping address for order #W2702727 to 1234 Elm St, Springfield, IL 62701, USA, there’s no second address line for it.
